hook.en: A newborn has about 300 bones, but an adult has 206, because many fuse as we grow. Today we count the adult ones — 80 down the middle and 126 in the limbs and girdles.
hook.kn: ನವಜಾತ ಶಿಶುವಿಗೆ ಸುಮಾರು 300 ಮೂಳೆಗಳಿರುತ್ತವೆ, ಆದರೆ ವಯಸ್ಕರಿಗೆ 206, ಏಕೆಂದರೆ ಬೆಳೆದಂತೆ ಅನೇಕ ಮೂಳೆಗಳು ಬೆಸೆಯುತ್ತವೆ. ಇಂದು ಮಧ್ಯದ 80 ಮತ್ತು ಅಂಗಗಳ 126 ಮೂಳೆಗಳನ್ನು ಎಣಿಸೋಣ.

narration.en: A newborn has about 300 bones, but an adult has 206, because many fuse as we grow. Today we count the adult ones — 80 down the middle and 126 in the limbs and girdles.
narration.kn: ನವಜಾತ ಶಿಶುವಿಗೆ ಸುಮಾರು 300 ಮೂಳೆಗಳಿರುತ್ತವೆ, ಆದರೆ ವಯಸ್ಕರಿಗೆ 206, ಏಕೆಂದರೆ ಬೆಳೆದಂತೆ ಅನೇಕ ಮೂಳೆಗಳು ಬೆಸೆಯುತ್ತವೆ. ಇಂದು ಮಧ್ಯದ 80 ಮತ್ತು ಅಂಗಗಳ 126 ಮೂಳೆಗಳನ್ನು ಎಣಿಸೋಣ.

body.en: The skeletal system has bones and a few cartilages; it has 206 bones in two divisions, axial and appendicular. The axial skeleton has 80 bones along the main axis of the body: the skull, vertebral column, sternum and ribs. The skull has 22 bones — 8 cranial bones forming the hard protective cranium and 14 facial bones — plus a single U-shaped hyoid bone at the base of the buccal cavity and three ear ossicles in each middle ear (malleus, incus and stapes). The skull joins the vertebral column through two occipital condyles (dicondylic skull). The vertebral column has 26 vertebrae: cervical 7, thoracic 12, lumbar 5, sacral 1 (fused) and coccygeal 1 (fused); the first vertebra is the atlas. There are 12 pairs of ribs. The first seven pairs are true ribs, attached dorsally to the thoracic vertebrae and ventrally to the sternum with hyaline cartilage. The 8th, 9th and 10th pairs (vertebrochondral or false ribs) join the cartilage of the seventh rib; the 11th and 12th pairs are floating ribs.
body.kn: 206 ಮೂಳೆಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಅಕ್ಷೀಯ ಅಸ್ಥಿಪಂಜರ 80. ತಲೆಬುರುಡೆಯಲ್ಲಿ 22 ಮೂಳೆಗಳು (8 ಕಪಾಲ, 14 ಮುಖ), ಜೊತೆಗೆ ಹಯಾಯ್ಡ್ ಮತ್ತು ಆರು ಕಿವಿ ಮೂಳೆಗಳು. ಬೆನ್ನೆಲುಬಿನಲ್ಲಿ 26 ಕಶೇರುಕಗಳು: 7 ಕತ್ತು, 12 ಎದೆ, 5 ಸೊಂಟ, 1 ತ್ರಿಕ, 1 ಬಾಲ. 12 ಜೊತೆ ಪಕ್ಕೆಲುಬುಗಳು: 7 ನಿಜ, 3 ಸುಳ್ಳು, 2 ತೇಲುವ.

body.en: Each limb has 30 bones. The fore limb has the humerus, radius and ulna, 8 carpals (wrist bones), 5 metacarpals (palm bones) and 14 phalanges (digits). The hind limb has the femur (thigh bone, the longest bone), tibia and fibula, 7 tarsals (ankle bones), 5 metatarsals and 14 phalanges; a cup-shaped patella covers the knee ventrally. Each half of the pectoral girdle has a clavicle (collar bone) and a scapula; the scapula's expanded acromion forms a depression with the clavicle, and its glenoid cavity articulates with the head of the humerus to form the shoulder joint. The pelvic girdle has two coxal bones, each formed by the fusion of the ilium, ischium and pubis; at their point of fusion is a cavity, the acetabulum, to which the thigh bone articulates. The two halves meet ventrally at the pubic symphysis.
body.kn: ಪ್ರತಿ ಅಂಗದಲ್ಲಿ 30 ಮೂಳೆಗಳು. ಮುಂಗೈ: ಹ್ಯೂಮರಸ್, ರೇಡಿಯಸ್-ಅಲ್ನಾ, 8 ಮಣಿಕಟ್ಟು, 5 ಅಂಗೈ, 14 ಬೆರಳು ಮೂಳೆಗಳು. ಕಾಲು: ಫೀಮರ್ (ಅತಿ ಉದ್ದದ ಮೂಳೆ), ಟಿಬಿಯಾ-ಫಿಬುಲಾ, 7 ಹಿಮ್ಮಡಿ, 5 ಅಂಗಾಲು, 14 ಬೆರಳು ಮೂಳೆಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಮಂಡಿಚಿಪ್ಪು. ಭುಜದ ಕವಚದಲ್ಲಿ ಕ್ಲಾವಿಕಲ್ ಮತ್ತು ಸ್ಕ್ಯಾಪುಲಾ; ಸೊಂಟದ ಕವಚದಲ್ಲಿ ಎರಡು ಕಾಕ್ಸಲ್ ಮೂಳೆಗಳು.

problem.en: Show that the human skeleton has 206 bones by adding up its parts.

steps.en: Axial: skull 22 + hyoid 1 + ear ossicles 6 = 29; vertebrae 26; sternum 1; ribs 12 pairs = 24. Total = 29 + 26 + 1 + 24 = 80.
Girdles: pectoral 2 × (clavicle + scapula) = 4; pelvic 2 coxal bones = 2. Appendicular = 120 + 4 + 2 = 126.

narration.en: Let us work this out together. Show that the human skeleton has 206 bones by adding up its parts.

body.en: Breakfast at 7, lunch at 12, tea at 5: 7 cervical, 12 thoracic, 5 lumbar vertebrae. Then 1 sacrum and 1 coccyx (both fused) make 26.
